rows.Origin: Bred by K.S. Gopalaswamiengar (India, 1980). Bred by G. Kasturi Rangan (India, 1980).
rows.Bloom: Mauve. Strong fragrance. Double (17-25 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
